blood culture results showed no growth at 1 week

concepts.why: Intravascular atypical cells were found on skin biopsy, which is a characteristic feature of intravascular lymphoma.

concepts.preferred_label: Immune-Related Adverse Event (IRAE) due to Pembrolizumab
concepts.why: The patient has a history of pembrolizumab treatment and developed a new skin eruption, which is consistent with an immune-related adverse event.
The patient has a low white blood cell count and low platelet count, which are indicative of pancytopenia.
The patient has a low hemoglobin level, which is consistent with anemia.
The patient has a skin eruption with atypical cells on biopsy, which could be consistent with cutaneous T-cell lymphoma.
The patient has a very low white blood cell count and low platelet count, which are indicative of severe aplastic anemia.

rationales.F04: The presence of widespread, nontender, erythematous patches and thin plaques with telangiectases and hyperpigmentation is highly suggestive of intravascular lymphoma.
rationales.F07: The low hemoglobin level is a strong indicator of anemia.
rationales.F08: The low platelet count is a strong indicator of pancytopenia.
rationales.F10: The presence of intravascular atypical cells on skin biopsy is highly specific for intravascular lymphoma and rules out other conditions like immune-related adverse events and cutaneous T-cell lymphoma.
